name: manual_409c00
claim: Email addresses in ALLOWED_GMAIL_COAUTHORS are NEVER checked for non-gmail domains. The gmail_allowed() gate in check_commit_message.sh only runs when the email ends in @gmail.com or @googlemail.com. Any personal domain (e.g. @cyre.me) stored in ALLOWED_GMAIL_COAUTHORS will silently fall through to DENIED. Fix: put non-gmail personal/org addresses in ALLOWED_EXACT_COAUTHOR_EMAILS instead.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-22: lawrence@cyre.me was in ALLOWED_GMAIL_COAUTHORS; commits with Co-authored-by: cyre <Lawrence@cyre.me> were rejected because gmail_allowed() is guarded by *@gmail.com check. Moved to ALLOWED_EXACT_COAUTHOR_EMAILS (case-insensitive tolower match). Fix in orama scripts/git/check_commit_message.sh, synced to PT via sync-attribution-guard-scripts.sh.
